versions.changelog:
- Updated skill name to "Gameinformer News" (from "Game Informer News").
- Refined tags and added hint_allow_substrings for improved discoverability (e.g., "gameinformer", "game informer", "game news", "gaming news").
- No changes to logic, structure, or source URL—documentation only.

Initial release — fetches and displays recent Game Informer headlines by section.

- Supports fetching separate RSS feeds for News, Reviews, Previews, and Features sections.
- Outputs only non-empty sections, each limited to 3–5 latest items by default.
- Lists stories in order: News, then Reviews, Previews, and Features, with titles as markdown links.
- Combined feed available when requested (all-in-one view).
- Omits empty sections and avoids outputting placeholders for unavailable data.
